parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 9; 
  reg [15:0] sram_dout; 
  reg rnw;

  always @(posedge clk) 
  begin 
  if( ena && rnw ) 
  ram_dout <= SRAM_DQ; 
  end 
  always @(negedge clk) 
  begin 
  if( !ram_cen ) 
  begin 
  if( &ram_wen[1:0] )

  SRAM_CE_N <= 1'b0;

  SRAM_WE_N <= 1'b1; 
  SRAM_UB_N <= 1'b0; 
  SRAM_LB_N <= 1'b0; 
  end 
  else 
  begin 
  SRAM_CE_N <= 1'b0; 
  SRAM_OE_N <= 1'b1; 
  SRAM_WE_N <= 1'b0; 
  SRAM_UB_N <= ram_wen[1]; 
  SRAM_LB_N <= ram_wen[0]; 
  end 
  end 
  else 
  begin 
  SRAM_CE_N <= 1'b1; 
  SRAM_OE_N <= 1'b1; 
  SRAM_WE_N <= 1'b1; 
  SRAM_UB_N <= 1'b1; 
  SRAM_LB_N <= 1'b1;
